name: dsh-magic-context
description: Magic Context — DeepSeek Harness adapter (Host / Agent / Client + profile bundle). Loads the shared Magic SQLite store and registers ctx_* tools, /ctx-* commands, knowledge injection, historian/dreamer scheduling, compaction policy, and the Typert Remote surface for the DSH client.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --splitting --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-session --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm --external @deepseek-ai/cordis && bun build src/doctor/cli.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm && bun build src/entries/agent.ts src/entries/compaction.ts src/entries/commands.ts src/entries/tools.ts src/entries/remote.ts src/entries/preset-include.ts --outdir dist/entries --target node --format esm --splitting --external @deepseek-ai/cordis --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-session --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic --external @deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter --external @deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-include && bun run build:workers && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.build:workers: bun build ../plugin/src/features/magic-context/migration-worker.ts ../plugin/src/features/magic-context/memory/embedding-worker.ts ../plugin/src/features/magic-context/memory/embedding-worker-process.ts ../plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/auto-search-worker.ts ../plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/raw-ordinal-warmup-worker.ts ../plugin/src/features/magic-context/compaction-marker-candidates-worker.ts ../plugin/src/features/magic-context/chunk-embedding-write-worker.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming '[name].[ext]' --target node --format esm --splitting --external onnxruntime-node --external onnxruntime-web --external sharp --external bun:ffi --external bun:sqlite --external node:sqlite && bun build ../plugin/src/features/magic-context/migration-worker.ts ../plugin/src/features/magic-context/memory/embedding-worker.ts ../plugin/src/features/magic-context/memory/embedding-worker-process.ts ../plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/auto-search-worker.ts ../plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/raw-ordinal-warmup-worker.ts ../plugin/src/features/magic-context/compaction-marker-candidates-worker.ts ../plugin/src/features/magic-context/chunk-embedding-write-worker.ts --outdir dist/entries --entry-naming '[name].[ext]' --target node --format esm --splitting --external onnxruntime-node --external onnxruntime-web --external sharp --external bun:ffi --external bun:sqlite --external node:sqlite
